title: The committed ops sidecars hold no fixture landing
goal: querylog.py prune-ops [--root R] [--store S] [--dry-run] deletes the ops lines whose item no item file in R's kb/_self/backlog and no commit message of R names, rewrites each sidecar header's row counts and prints counts per event; --dry-run changes nothing; querylog.py check exits 0 after it; it is run once on kb/_querylog as gate g1 says, and querylog.md says when to run it.

run: import sys,json,subprocess as sp,tempfile,shutil;from pathlib import Path;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import ql_store as s;t=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp());S=t/'s';R=t/'r';b=R/'kb/_self/backlog';b.mkdir(parents=True);(b/'ST-aaaaaaaa.json').write_text('{}');g=lambda *a:sp.run(['git','-C',str(R),'-c','user.name=x','-c','user.email=x@x','-c','commit.gpgsign=false',*a],capture_output=True);g('init','-q');g('add','.');g('commit','-q','-m','m','-m','KB-Work: ST-bbbbbbbb');rid='20261007T100000Z-abcdef01';p=S/'2026-10'/(rid+'.jsonl');p.parent.mkdir(parents=True);p.write_text(json.dumps(s.header(rid,{'entries':0,'dropped':0,'waiting':0}))+'\n');s.write_ops(S,rid,[{'id':'11111111-1111-4111-8111-11111111111'+n,'ts':'2026-10-07T10:00:00.000Z','event':'land.end','item':'ST-'+c*8,'exit':0,'ms':5} for n,c in zip('123','abc')]);q=lambda *a:sp.run([sys.executable,'_tools/querylog.py',*a],capture_output=True,text=True);d=q('prune-ops','--dry-run','--root',str(R),'--store',str(S));r=q('prune-ops','--root',str(R),'--store',str(S));k=[w['item'] for _,w in s.load_run(s.ops_files(S)[0])[1:]];c=q('check',str(S));shutil.rmtree(t);print('dry',d.returncode,'run',r.returncode,'kept',k,'check',c.returncode);sys.exit(0 if (d.returncode,r.returncode,c.returncode)==(0,0,0) and k==['ST-aaaaaaaa','ST-bbbbbbbb'] else 1)
